appDescription: A local vehicle observation and driver concern journal with explicit handover and inspection records.

function.name: QUERY_CARITDA_CONTEXT
function.description: Read received vehicle values, battery charge, driver concerns, handover records or tire data availability. Does not diagnose, save records or call Gemini.

topic.description: The requested kind of local vehicle context.

function.name: DRAFT_CARITDA_ISSUE
function.description: Prepares text for a driver concern. The user must choose the recording person, review the draft and explicitly save. Does not diagnose or request an AI explanation.

situation.description: The symptoms stated by the user without invented details.

function.name: ANALYZE_CARITDA_ISSUE
function.description: Explain one explicitly selected existing symptom record. Use existing to read a saved explanation or new only when the user explicitly requests a new Gemini analysis. Requires account, consent, device authorization and available quota. Does not confirm a diagnosis.

record_query.description: An exact identifying phrase from one existing symptom. Do not guess what this or that refers to.

request_mode.description: Use new only for an explicit request for a new analysis; existing does not call a model.
